hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: The varieties encompassed in the Yelmek [jel] entry show lexicostatistical figures which are difficult to interpret as varieties of the same language. At least one more language appears to be necessary, i.e., the most distant Wanam (**hh:g:Gregor:Yelmek**:21-33). See also: Southern Yelmek [jel].
